sources.entry: strawberry-django - Strawberry GraphQL integration with Django.

summary.one_liner: Strawberry GraphQL integration for Django that generates GraphQL types, queries, mutations and resolvers from Django models.
summary.what_it_does: Provides tools to build GraphQL APIs on top of Django by generating GraphQL types from Django models. The README lists filtering with lookups (contains, exact, in), offset and cursor-based (Relay) pagination, and ordering by field. It also covers auto-generated create, update and delete mutations with validation, and Django auth integration with a permission system. A query optimizer adds select_related and prefetch_related to avoid N+1 queries. It works with Django views (sync and async), and includes GraphiQL with Django Debug Toolbar integration.
use_cases: Expose Django models as a GraphQL API
Build filterable, paginated GraphQL list queries
Auto-generate CRUD mutations for Django models
Avoid N+1 database queries in GraphQL resolvers
Add GraphQL endpoints to existing Django projects
how_to_run: Define Django models and Strawberry types with @strawberry_django.type(Model)
Expose the schema via strawberry.django.views.AsyncGraphQLView.as_view(schema=schema) in urls.py
Visit the /graphql/ endpoint to use GraphiQL
notable: Generates GraphQL types directly from Django models with type annotations (auto)
Query optimizer prevents N+1 queries via select_related and prefetch_related
Supports both sync and async Django views
Built-in offset and Relay cursor pagination
GraphiQL integration with Django Debug Toolbar
caveats: README does not state platform or version limits
Advanced features such as permissions and ordering are described only briefly; details are in external documentation
